notes.title: Reberryon Release
notes.notes:
Our team has been working on this game for seven weeks as part of a course. It has been an honor to collaborate with so many talented people to bring this project to life. The game is now released, and as an experiment, we decided to make it available for the same price as a rock you might find outside your apartment, stuck in the water drains next to the road -> FREE! Thank you once again for your support.

Stay hånking fellas, stay hånking.
